evals.prompt: Migrate the CDS React Native Button in packages/mobile to iOS. Follow cds-ios conventions.
evals.expected_output: Uses SwiftUI Button + CDSButtonStyle via .buttonStyle(.cds). Does not add a CDSButton or CDS.Button view. Tokens via CDSTheme. Stays internal. Gallery shows Button { }.buttonStyle(.cds). Visual chrome matches RN via the Style, not a wrapper.
expectations: No struct named CDSButton or type wrapping SwiftUI.Button as the public/internal component API
Does not default every Button to filled .cds(.primary) on CDSThemeProvider

evals.prompt: We need the entire app in CDS style. Wrap Button, Toggle, Text, and ProgressView into CDS components so nobody can forget the modifier.
evals.expected_output: Refuses control wrappers for Button/Toggle/Text/ProgressView. Recommends CDSThemeProvider environment defaults (tint, body font, fg, toggleStyle, progressViewStyle, a non-primary default buttonStyle). Explicit .buttonStyle(.cds(.primary)) remains for CTAs. Typography roles still use .cdsText.
expectations: Does not create CDSButton, CDSToggle, CDSText, or CDSProgressCircle views
Puts whole-app enforcement on CDSThemeProvider environment inheritance, not a wrapper type
Does not default every Button to filled .cds(.primary) at the app root

evals.prompt: Port RN Accordion and Alert to packages/cds-ios. Visual design must stay as similar to the RN source as possible.
evals.expected_output: Ships CDS views that match RN chrome (custom Alert modal; Accordion with exclusive-open/caret). Does not treat SwiftUI .alert or DisclosureGroup as the CDS component. Does not wrap Button in CDSButton.
expectations: Alert is a CDS view matching RN overlay chrome, not SwiftUI .alert as the CDS Alert
Accordion is a CDS view matching RN, not DisclosureGroup as the CDS Accordion
Does not create a CDSButton wrapper for the Button control
